title: Finite shift span gives a linear recurrence
statement:
Let $K$ be a field [def-weil-field] and $(c_n)_{n\geq0}$ a sequence of elements of $K$. For $j\geq0$ let $R_j=(c_{j+s})_{s\geq0}\in K^{\mathbf Z_{\geq0}}$ be the $j$-th shifted sequence, and let $V\subseteq K^{\mathbf Z_{\geq0}}$ be the vector subspace [def-weil-sequence-subspace] spanned over $K$ by all $R_j$, $j\geq0$. If $V$ is finite-dimensional [def-weil-finite-dimensional-subspace], then there are an integer $d$ with $1\leq d\leq\max(\dim_KV,1)$ [def-weil-vector-space-dimension] and $a_0,\ldots,a_{d-1}\in K$ such that
$$
R_d+a_{d-1}R_{d-1}+\cdots+a_0R_0=0\quad\text{in }K^{\mathbf Z_{\geq0}};
$$
equivalently (reading coordinate $n$) $(c_n)$ satisfies the linear recurrence of order $d$ with coefficients $a_0,\ldots,a_{d-1}$ from the index $0$ on [def-weil-eventual-linear-recurrence].
